visual_style: Two stacked regions: the subject or action above, captions, a diagram or a complementary picture below.
rights_requirements: Both panels use generated, stock, approved or owned visuals — never unrelated or unauthorised footage to fill a panel.
render_notes: The top panel shows the middle of each shot's picture; the bottom panel is text on the format's panel colour, or a second picture.
platform_notes: Also the video form of the picture-above, text-below card.
format: the picture in the top half and the words — captions, a headline or a second picture — in the bottom half
